lines.text: Can you lend me a pen?
Many learners say: Can you borrow me a pen?
Better: Can you lend me a pen?
Lend means give for a short time.
Lend! Can you lend me a pen?

data.wrong: Can you borrow me a pen?
data.right: Can you lend me a pen?
data.why: Lend means give for a short time.

native.tip: Im Deutschen heißt „leihen“ geben und nehmen. Im Englischen geben Sie mit „lend“ und nehmen mit „borrow“.

en.tip: German “leihen” means both giving and taking. English uses “lend” for giving and “borrow” for taking.
en.caption: “Leihen” has two English words! Wrong: “Can you borrow me a pen?” Right: “Can you lend me a pen?” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
